project.name: Gemini FoodLog
project.summary: An autonomous, uncertainty-aware food journal reconstructed from ordinary, unstaged kitchen activity.
project.ai_usage: Gemini 3.6 Flash through Google ADK uses ordered images and bounded account-scoped context tools to produce evidence-linked, revisable meal hypotheses.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped design, implement, test, secure, deploy, evaluate, and document the project while Oana retained spending, privacy, product, publication, and submission decisions.
